description: Source code for RSA signature verification, including functions for buffer dumping, ASCII-hex conversions, signature file processing, manifest handling, hash computation, and signature verification using OpenSSL. It is part of a larger RDM API for secure package validation.

methods.name: dump_buffer
methods.description: Outputs buffer data to stdout and binary file, used for debugging.

methods.name: asciihex_to_bin
methods.description: Converts ASCII hex string to binary data.

methods.name: bin_to_asciihex
methods.description: Converts binary data to ASCII hex string.

methods.name: prepare_sig_file
methods.description: Prepares signature file by removing header bytes and moving the file.

methods.name: prepare_app_manifest
methods.description: Adds prefix to each line of manifest file and appends padding file path.

methods.name: prepare_kms_pubkey_config
methods.description: Retrieves KMS public key from config (if LIBRDKCONFIG_BUILD) or executes system command.

methods.name: prepare_rdm_files_for_sign_verification
methods.description: Prepares necessary files for signature verification, including signature, manifest, padding, and public key.

methods.name: rdm_signature_verify
methods.description: Performs signature verification process, including file preparation and OpenSSL verification.

methods.name: read_signature_file
methods.description: Reads and decodes ASCII hex signature file into binary buffer.

methods.name: rdm_openssl_file_hash_sha256
methods.description: Calculates SHA256 hash of a data file.

methods.name: rdm_openssl_file_hash_sha256_pkg_components
methods.description: Calculates SHA256 hash over package components listed in manifest.

methods.name: openssl_verify_signature
methods.description: Verifies signature against hash using OpenSSL.

methods.name: rdm_openssl_rsa_file_signature_verify
methods.description: Main function to verify RSA signature of a file using OpenSSL.
